```css
.ticket-summary { margin: 6px 0 12px; color: var(--text-2); }
.ticket-cell { white-space: nowrap; }
.ticket-link {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    font: inherit;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--link);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.ticket-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

/* STARS: next to any ticket number, wherever it shows */
.star-btn {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    padding: 0 4px;
    margin-left: 4px;
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    line-height: 1;
    color: var(--faint);
    cursor: pointer;
    vertical-align: baseline;
}
.star-btn:hover { color: var(--warn); }
.star-btn.on { color: var(--warn); }
.star-btn.labelled {
    margin-left: 0;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 6px 12px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text);
}
.star-btn.labelled.on { color: var(--warn-ink); background: var(--warn-soft); border-color: var(--warn-line); }
.dashboard-toolbar .star-btn.labelled { flex-shrink: 0; margin-left: auto; }

/* TICKET ROWS IN AI ANSWERS: click to open the full record and related tickets */
.result-table tbody tr.expandable { cursor: pointer; }
.result-table tbody tr.expandable:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; }
.result-table tbody tr.expanded,
.result-table tbody tr.expanded:nth-child(even) { background: var(--accent-soft); }
.expand-caret { display: inline-block; width: 1em; color: var(--faint); transition: transform 0.15s; }
tr.expanded .expand-caret { transform: rotate(90deg); color: var(--accent); }
/* The opened view: under its row, kept in sight when the table scrolls sideways */
.result-table tbody tr.row-detail,
.result-table tbody tr.row-detail:nth-child(even),
.result-table tbody tr.row-detail:hover { background: var(--surface-2); }
.result-table tr.row-detail > td { padding: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent); }
.row-detail-body {
    position: sticky;
    left: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: min(1100px, calc(100vw - 120px));
    padding: 12px 16px 16px;
    border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
}
.row-detail-close {
    float: right;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.row-detail-close:hover { background: var(--panel-bg); }
/* A table with an opened row shows in full, instead of in a short scrolling box */
.table-wrap:has(tr.row-detail) { max-height: none; }

/* RELATED TICKETS: under an AI answer, and under a ticket's record on Home */
.related { margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.related-title { font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.related-loading { margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }
.family { margin-bottom: 16px; padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--panel-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-left: 3px solid var(--info); border-radius: 6px; }
.family-title { font-weight: 600; }
.family-why { margin: 4px 0 8px; color: var(--text-2); font-size: 0.87rem; line-height: 1.45; }
.family-line { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px 12px; margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.5; }
.same-label, .differ-label { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 4px; }
.same-label { background: var(--same-bg); color: var(--same-ink); }
.differ-label { background: var(--differ-bg); color: var(--differ-ink); }
.fact b { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-2); }
.family-more { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.8rem; }
.family .table-wrap { max-height: 320px; margin-top: 8px; }
/* "Download all N families as" above the families */
.related > .download-bar { margin: 0 0 12px; }
/* The ticket (or tickets) the question was about, in each family */
.result-table tbody tr.focus,
.result-table tbody tr.focus:nth-child(even) { background: var(--info-soft); }
.result-table tbody tr.focus td:first-child { box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--info); }

/* "Star all": under an AI answer's table, and above Ticket results */
.star-all-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 10px 0; }
.star-many {
    background: var(--warn-softer);
    border: 1px solid var(--warn-line);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    color: var(--warn-ink);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.star-many:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--warn-soft); }
.star-many:disabled { background: transparent; border-color: var(--border); color: var(--muted); cursor: default; }

.toast {
    position: fixed;
    left: 50%;
    bottom: 24px;
    transform: translate(-50%, 20px);
    background: var(--toast-bg);
    color: var(--toast-text);
    padding: 10px 18px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    z-index: 50;
    max-width: calc(100% - 32px);
}
.toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }

@media (max-width: 700px) {
    .home { padding: 16px 16px 32px; }
    .home-modes { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
}

/* CHAT AREA ARCHITECTURE */
.chat-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 20px auto;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    height: calc(100% - 40px);
}

.chat-messages {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 20px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 15px;
}

.msg { padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 6px; max-width: 75%; line-height: 1.5; }
.system-msg { background: var(--surface-3); align-self: center; text-align: center; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.user-msg { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); align-self: flex-end; }
.ai-msg { background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); align-self: flex-start; }

.chat-input-area {
    display: flex;
    padding: 15px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    gap: 10px;
}

.chat-input-area input {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 12px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 1rem;
}

.chat-input-area button {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--on-accent);
    border: none;
    padding: 0 24px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: 600;
}

/* Secondary: clears the chat and Claude's memory of it */
.chat-input-area #new-chat-btn {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--text);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 0 16px;
}
.chat-input-area #new-chat-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-primary); }

/* DASHBOARD PANEL */
.dashboard-container { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

/* Top-left: the drawer button and the dashboard that's showing */
.dashboard-toolbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 14px;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--panel-bg);
}
.drawer-toggle {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--on-accent);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.drawer-toggle span { font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1; }
.dashboard-current { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.dashboard-current-group { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }
.dashboard-current-group:not(:empty)::after { content: ' ›'; }
.dashboard-current-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; }
.dashboard-current-desc { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }
/* Back from a detail page that a click on a chart opened */
.dashboard-back {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 7px 12px;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text);
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}
.dashboard-back:hover { background: var(--bg-primary); }
.dashboard-hint { margin-left: auto; color: var(--faint); font-size: 0.8rem; white-space: nowrap; }

/* The drawer slides over the dashboard from the left */
.dashboard-body { position: relative; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; }
.dashboard-backdrop {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: var(--backdrop);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
    z-index: 2;
}
.dashboard-backdrop.open { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
.dashboard-drawer {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: min(320px, 85vw);
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
    box-shadow: 4px 0 16px var(--shadow);
    overflow-y: auto;
    transform: translateX(-100%);
    visibility: hidden;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, visibility 0.2s;
    z-index: 3;
}
.dashboard-drawer.open { transform: none; visibility: visible; }
.drawer-header {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 14px 16px 6px;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.drawer-close { background: none; border: none; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 6px; }
.drawer-close:hover { color: var(--text); }
.drawer-group { padding: 6px 8px 10px; }
.drawer-group h3 {
    margin: 8px 8px 4px;
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted);
}
.dashboard-choice {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    border-left: 3px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    color: var(--text);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.dashboard-choice:hover { background: var(--bg-primary); }
.dashboard-choice.active { background: var(--accent-soft); border-left-color: var(--accent); }
.dashboard-choice-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.dashboard-choice-desc { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.35; }

.dashboard-message { margin: 40px auto; max-width: 560px; text-align: center; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.6; }
#dashboard-frame { flex: 1; width: 100%; border: 0; }

@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .dashboard-toolbar { padding: 10px 16px; }
    .dashboard-current-desc { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
    .dashboard-hint { display: none; }
}
/* ❔ Tour, at the right end (after the star or the hint when they show) */
.dashboard-tour-btn { margin-left: auto; flex-shrink: 0; }
.dashboard-toolbar .star-btn:not([hidden]) ~ .dashboard-tour-btn { margin-left: 0; }
@media (min-width: 1101px) {
    .dashboard-hint:not([hidden]) ~ .dashboard-tour-btn { margin-left: 0; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .tour-btn-word { display: none; }
}

/* While a question is being answered: finished steps above the current one */
.query-progress { min-width: 260px; }
.progress-done { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }
.progress-current { font-weight: 600; }
.progress-time { margin-left: 6px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 400; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

/* RESULT TABLES */
.ai-msg.wide { max-width: 100%; width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }
/* "Answered in 2.8 s" under each answer */
.result-timing { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 0.78rem; }

.result-title { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.result-caption { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.result-empty { margin: 4px 0; color: var(--text-2); }
/* Why a question found nothing (dates covered, which condition emptied it) */
.result-explanation {
    margin: 6px 0 4px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    background: var(--note-bg);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--warn);
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: var(--text);
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.result-big { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); margin: 4px 0 8px; }
.result-big span { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text); }

.table-wrap {
    overflow: auto;
    max-height: 480px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
}

.result-table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 0.875rem; }
.result-table th,
.result-table td {
    padding: 8px 12px;
    text-align: left;
    vertical-align: top;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.result-table thead th {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    background: var(--surface-3);
    font-weight: 600;
    white-space: nowrap;
    z-index: 1;
}
.result-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: var(--zebra); }
.result-table tbody tr:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); }
.result-table td { min-width: 90px; }
.result-table .num { text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
.result-table td[title] { cursor: help; }

/* Single-ticket lookups: label on the left, value on the right */
.result-table.detail th { width: 200px; background: var(--surface-2); white-space: nowrap; }
.result-table.detail td.long { white-space: pre-wrap; max-width: 700px; }

.assumptions { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.assumptions summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted); }
.assumptions ul { margin: 6px 0 0; padding-left: 20px; }

/* Tables that combine several ticket types */
.section-title { font-weight: 600; margin: 14px 0 4px; }
.result-table tfoot td {
    position: sticky;
    bottom: 0;
    background: var(--surface-3);
    font-weight: 700;
    border-top: 2px solid var(--border);
}
.result-table td.total { font-weight: 600; }

/* Download bar under each result */
.download-bar {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--text-2);
}
.download-bar select {
    padding: 5px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.download-bar button {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--on-accent);
    border: none;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.download-bar button:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: wait; }
.download-status { color: var(--muted); }
.download-status.error { color: var(--danger); }

/* =====================================================================
   CUSTOMIZING (customize.js): the colors panel, Home's layout, each
   person's own dashboards, the chart builder, and the charts (charts.js)
   ===================================================================== */

/* Anything hidden stays hidden, whatever display a rule gives it */
[hidden] { display: none !important; }

/* Buttons: the main action in the accent color */
.primary-btn {
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--on-accent);
    border: 1px solid var(--accent);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.primary-btn:hover { filter: brightness(0.93); }
.primary-btn:focus-visible,
.home-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* 🎨 Colors: drops down under the header's right side */
.theme-panel {
    position: fixed;
    top: 58px;
    right: 16px;
    z-index: 40;
    width: min(380px, calc(100vw - 32px));
    max-height: calc(100vh - 80px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 12px 16px 14px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 40px var(--shadow-strong);
}
.theme-panel-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.theme-panel fieldset,
.builder fieldset { border: none; margin: 0 0 14px; padding: 0; min-width: 0; }
.theme-panel legend,
.builder legend { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-2); padding: 0; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.legend-note { font-weight: 400; color: var(--muted); }
.theme-panel-foot {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding-top: 10px;
}
.theme-note { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted); flex: 1 1 180px; line-height: 1.4; }

/* Radio buttons drawn as pills and color swatches (the real input stays, for keyboards) */
.choice-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
.choice-pill, .display-choice, .swatch { position: relative; }
.choice-pill input, .display-choice input, .swatch input[type="radio"] {
    position: absolute;
    opacity: 0;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: 0;
}
.choice-pill span {
    display: inline-block;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 5px 12px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--text-2);
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.choice-pill span:hover { border-color: var(--faint); }
.choice-pill input:checked + span { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
.choice-pill input:focus-visible + span,
.display-choice input:focus-visible + span,
.swatch input:focus-visible + span { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.swatch-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.swatch { display: inline-flex; cursor: pointer; }
.swatch span {
    display: block;
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}
.swatch input:checked + span,
.swatch-custom.on .swatch-custom-face { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--panel-bg), 0 0 0 4px var(--text); }
/* "Any color": the browser's color picker, under a rainbow button */
.swatch-custom input[type="color"] {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    opacity: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
}
.swatch-custom input[type="color"]:focus-visible + .swatch-custom-face { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.swatch-custom-face {
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: conic-gradient(#e34948, #eda100, #1baf7a, #2a78d6, #6250d6, #d55181, #e34948);
    color: #ffffff;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
}

/* HOME: the welcome with "Customize Home", then each section and chart */
.home-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.home-head .home-welcome { margin: 0; }
.home-edit-bar {
    background: var(--accent-softer);
    border: 1px solid var(--accent);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}
.home-edit-text { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.45; }
.home-edit-actions, .home-add-back { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.home-add-back:empty { display: none; }
.home-empty { padding: 24px; text-align: center; background: var(--panel-bg); border: 1px dashed var(--border); border-radius: 8px; }
.home-blocks {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 16px;
    align-items: start;
}
/* Until this person's layout has loaded (no flash of the default one) */
.home-blocks.waiting { visibility: hidden; }
.home-block[data-block] { grid-column: 1 / -1; min-width: 0; }
.home-block > .search-guide { margin-bottom: 0; }
.home-block .home-modes { margin-bottom: 12px; }
/* While customizing, each section is outlined and has its own buttons */
.home.editing .home-block[data-block] { outline: 2px dashed var(--border); outline-offset: 6px; border-radius: 8px; }
.block-bar { display: none; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.home.editing .block-bar { display: flex; }
.block-name { font-weight: 700; margin-right: auto; }
.home-action:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

/* "Your dashboards" section on Home */
.shortcuts-card { max-width: none; }
.shortcut-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-top: 6px; }
.shortcut {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 2px;
    text-align: left;
    background: var(--surface-2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    color: var(--text);
    font: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.shortcut:hover { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-softer); }
.shortcut.new { border-style: dashed; }
.shortcut-name { font-weight: 600; }
.shortcut-desc { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted); }

/* DASHBOARDS DRAWER: "My dashboards", and hiding team dashboards */
.drawer-new {
    display: block;
    width: calc(100% - 16px);
    margin: 4px 8px 0;
    text-align: left;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px dashed var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    color: var(--accent-ink);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.drawer-new:hover { background: var(--accent-softer); border-color: var(--accent); }
.drawer-note { margin: 4px 10px 6px; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.4; }
.drawer-note:empty { display: none; }
.drawer-foot { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 10px 8px 16px; margin-top: 4px; }
.drawer-customize {
    width: 100%;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--text-2);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.drawer-customize:hover,
.drawer-customize[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); }
.dashboard-choice { position: relative; }
.choice-check { display: none; }
.dashboard-drawer.editing #dashboard-picker .dashboard-choice { padding-left: 38px; }
.dashboard-drawer.editing .choice-check {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    position: absolute;
    left: 10px;
    top: 10px;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    border: 2px solid var(--accent);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: var(--on-accent);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
}
.dashboard-drawer.editing .choice-check::after { content: '✓'; }
.dashboard-drawer.editing .is-hidden .choice-check { background: transparent; border-color: var(--faint); }
.dashboard-drawer.editing .is-hidden .choice-check::after { content: ''; }
.dashboard-drawer.editing .is-hidden .dashboard-choice-name,
.dashboard-drawer.editing .is-hidden .dashboard-choice-desc { opacity: 0.5; }

/* ONE OF YOUR OWN DASHBOARDS: its buttons, then its charts */
.board-view { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 16px 20px 32px; }
.board-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.tile-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: 16px;
    align-items: start;
}
.board-empty {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    max-width: 560px;
    margin: 32px auto;
    padding: 24px;
    text-align: center;
    color: var(--text-2);
    line-height: 1.55;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px dashed var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
}
.board-empty p { margin: 0; }
.board-empty .board-empty-title { font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.board-empty-actions { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; }

/* A CHART: its title and what it counts, its buttons, the drawing */
.chart-tile {
    grid-column: span 6;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 12px 14px 14px;
}
.chart-tile.size-small { grid-column: span 4; }
.chart-tile.size-large { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.tile-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.tile-titles { flex: 1 1 200px; min-width: 0; }
.tile-actions { margin-left: auto; }
.tile-title { margin: 0; font-size: 0.98rem; font-weight: 650; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.tile-sub { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.35; }
/* The buttons show on hover or keyboard focus (always on touch screens and while customizing) */
.tile-actions { display: flex; gap: 2px; flex-shrink: 0; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.15s; }
.chart-tile:hover .tile-actions,
.chart-tile:focus-within .tile-actions,
.home.editing .tile-actions { opacity: 1; }
@media (hover: none) {
    .tile-actions { opacity: 1; }
}
.tile-btn {
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 3px 7px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
    color: var(--muted);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.tile-btn:hover { background: var(--surface-2); border-color: var(--border); color: var(--text); }
.tile-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
.tile-btn[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--accent-ink); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.tile-body { position: relative; min-width: 0; transition: opacity 0.15s; }
/* New numbers loading: the old drawing stays, dimmed (no jump to "Loading…") */
.tile-body.refreshing { opacity: 0.45; }
.chart-note { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted); }
.chart-loading, .chart-empty { margin: 16px 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.88rem; }
.chart-empty.error { color: var(--danger); }
.chart-table { max-height: 340px; }
.chart-table .result-table td { min-width: 0; }

/* The drawings: hairline grid and axis, thin marks, text in text colors */
.chart-svg { display: block; overflow: visible; max-width: 100%; height: auto; font-family: inherit; }
.chart-grid { stroke: var(--chart-grid); stroke-width: 1; shape-rendering: crispEdges; }
.chart-axis { stroke: var(--chart-axis); stroke-width: 1; shape-rendering: crispEdges; }
.chart-tick { fill: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chart-label { fill: var(--text-2); font-size: 12px; }
.chart-value { fill: var(--text); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chart-hit { fill: var(--text); fill-opacity: 0; outline: none; }
.chart-hit.hover,
.chart-hit:focus-visible { fill-opacity: 0.06; }
.chart-hit:focus-visible { stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 2; }
.line-hit:focus-visible { fill-opacity: 0; }
.chart-line { fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
.chart-area { fill-opacity: 0.1; }
.chart-dot { stroke: var(--panel-bg); stroke-width: 2; }
.chart-cross { stroke: var(--faint); stroke-width: 1; shape-rendering: crispEdges; }
/* Donut slices: a 2px gap in the background color between them */
.slice { stroke: var(--panel-bg); stroke-width: 2; outline: none; }
.slice.hover { opacity: 0.82; }
.slice:focus-visible { stroke: var(--text); }
.chart-donut-total { fill: var(--text); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; }
.chart-donut { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
.chart-donut.side { flex-direction: row; gap: 20px; }
.chart-legend { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 5px; font-size: 0.82rem; min-width: 0; flex: 1; width: 100%; }
.chart-legend li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.legend-key { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; }
.legend-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--text-2); }
.legend-value { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.legend-share { min-width: 3.4em; text-align: right; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
/* One number: the total, big */
.chart-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 6px 0 2px; }
.chart-stat-value { font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.05; color: var(--text); }
.chart-stat-label { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 2px; }
/* The tooltip: the value first, then what it is */
.chart-tip {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 70;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    max-width: 280px;
    padding: 6px 10px;
    pointer-events: none;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 18px var(--shadow);
    font-size: 0.82rem;
}
.chart-tip.show { display: flex; }
.chart-tip strong { font-size: 0.95rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chart-tip span { color: var(--muted); }

@media (max-width: 1000px) {
    .chart-tile.size-small { grid-column: span 6; }
    .chart-tile.size-medium { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .chart-tile.size-small { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
    .board-view { padding: 12px 16px 24px; }
    .header-btn, .sign-out-btn { padding: 5px 9px; }
}

/* THE CHART BUILDER: the choices on the left, a live preview on the right */
dialog::backdrop { background: var(--backdrop); }
dialog.builder {
    width: min(1100px, calc(100vw - 32px));
    max-width: none;
    max-height: calc(100vh - 32px);
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 60px var(--shadow-strong);
}
.builder-form { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: calc(100vh - 34px); }
.builder-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 14px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.builder-head h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.builder-body {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1.15fr);
    gap: 24px;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    min-height: 0;
}
.builder-fields select,
.builder-fields input[type="text"],
.builder-fields input[type="date"],
.builder-fields input[type="search"],
.ask-dialog input {
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}
.field-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.field-label-text { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-2); min-width: 44px; }
.field-note { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.4; }
.field-note:empty { display: none; }
.date-range { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 6px; }
.date-range label { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.filter-row { margin-top: 10px; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; }
.filter-top { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.filter-field { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.filter-count { padding-bottom: 8px; font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; }
.filter-values { max-height: 168px; overflow-y: auto; margin-top: 6px; background: var(--panel-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; }
.filter-value {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 8px;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font-size: 0.84rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.filter-value:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.filter-value:hover { background: var(--accent-softer); }
.filter-value input { accent-color: var(--accent); margin: 0; }
.filter-value-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.filter-value-count { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.filter-more { margin: 6px 8px; font-size: 0.76rem; color: var(--muted); }
#b-add-filter { margin-top: 10px; }
.display-picker { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(86px, 1fr)); gap: 6px; }
.display-choice span {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 8px 4px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: var(--text-2);
    text-align: center;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.display-choice svg { color: var(--muted); }
.display-choice span:hover { border-color: var(--faint); }
.display-choice input:checked + span { background: var(--accent-soft); border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); color: var(--text); }
.display-choice input:checked + span svg { color: var(--accent); }
.display-choice input:disabled + span,
.choice-pill input:disabled + span { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }
.builder-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 14px; margin-top: 10px; }
.builder-row .field-label { margin-top: 0; flex: 1 1 140px; }
.builder-preview { position: sticky; top: 0; align-self: start; min-width: 0; }
.builder-preview-label { margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.chart-tile.preview { box-shadow: 0 2px 12px var(--shadow); }
.builder-foot { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
@media (max-width: 820px) {
    .builder-body { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
    .builder-preview { position: static; order: -1; }
}

/* "Name it" box */
dialog.ask-dialog {
    width: min(420px, calc(100vw - 32px));
    padding: 18px 20px 0;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 60px var(--shadow-strong);
}
.ask-dialog h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.ask-dialog .builder-foot { padding: 14px 0 16px; border-top: none; }

/* =====================================================================
   AI ANSWERS AS CHARTS, CLICKING THROUGH TO TICKETS, DASHBOARD FILTERS,
   SHARING AND THE TOUR
   ===================================================================== */

.home-head-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }

/* "Show as": the answer's table or one of its charts */
.answer-views { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin: 4px 0 8px; }
.answer-views-label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); margin-right: 2px; }
.view-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 4px 11px;
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    color: var(--text-2);
    cursor: pointer;
}
.view-btn svg { color: var(--muted); }
.view-btn:hover { border-color: var(--faint); }
.view-btn.active { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
.view-btn.active svg { color: var(--on-accent); }
.view-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.view-btn.save { margin-left: auto; color: var(--accent-ink); border-style: dashed; }
.view-btn.save:hover { background: var(--accent-softer); border-color: var(--accent); }
.answer-chart { background: var(--panel-bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 14px; }
.answer-chart .chart-note { margin-bottom: 0; }

/* Marks that open their tickets */
.drillable .chart-hit:not(.line-hit),
.drillable .slice,
.drillable .line-hit,
.drillable .chart-stat { cursor: pointer; }
.drillable .chart-stat:hover .chart-stat-value { color: var(--accent-ink); }
.chart-stat:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 4px; }

/* The tooltip of a chart with several series: one row per series */
.tip-rows:empty, .tip-hint:empty { display: none; }
.tip-rows { display: grid; gap: 2px; margin-top: 4px; }
.tip-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 6px; align-items: center; color: var(--text-2); }
.tip-row b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text); }
.tip-key { width: 10px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }
.tip-hint { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--accent-ink); }

/* The legend above a chart of several series */
.chart-series-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 16px; margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.series-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.series-key { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; }
.series-key.line { width: 14px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

/* Pictures of charts are drawn here, off screen, always in the light colors */
.picture-host {
    position: fixed;
    left: -20000px;
    top: 0;
    width: 912px;
    visibility: hidden;
    color-scheme: light;
    --bg-primary: #f4f6f9;
    --panel-bg: #ffffff;
    --text: #2d3748;
    --text-2: #4a5568;
    --muted: #718096;
    --faint: #a0aec0;
    --border: #e2e8f0;
    --chart-grid: #edf0f3;
    --chart-axis: #cbd2d9;
    --chart-other: #a0aec0;
    --series-1: #2a78d6;
    --series-2: #eb6834;
    --series-3: #1baf7a;
    --series-4: #eda100;
    --series-5: #e87ba4;
    --series-6: #008300;
    --series-7: #6250d6;
    --series-8: #e34948;
}

/* ⤓ under a chart */
.tile-download { margin-top: 8px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
.tile-download .download-bar { margin-top: 0; }
.download-note { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.78rem; }
.download-note:empty { display: none; }
.download-bar option:disabled { color: var(--faint); }

/* A dashboard's filter row */
.board-filters {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px 12px;
    margin: -4px 0 14px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--text-2);
}
.board-filters-label { font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); }
.board-filter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.board-filters select,
.board-filters input[type="date"],
.team-pop input[type="search"] {
    padding: 5px 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.team-picker { position: relative; }
#bf-team-btn.on,
#board-share-btn.on { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-softer); color: var(--accent-ink); }
.team-pop {
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(100% + 6px);
    left: 0;
    z-index: 5;
    width: min(340px, calc(100vw - 48px));
    padding: 10px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 30px var(--shadow-strong);
}
.team-pop input[type="search"] { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; }
.team-pop .filter-values { max-height: 240px; }
.team-pop-note { margin: 6px 2px 0; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted); }
.team-pop-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; margin-top: 8px; }

/* The builder: a note at the top, conditions with how they match, where to save */
.builder-note { margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--accent-softer); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.45; }
.filter-top .filter-op { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.filter-text { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 4px; padding: 7px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel-bg); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.builder-dest { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-right: auto; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.builder-dest select { padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--panel-bg); color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; max-width: 260px; }

/* The tickets behind a chart, and a shared dashboard's preview */
.drill-body, .shared-body { padding: 14px 20px 20px; overflow-y: auto; max-height: calc(100vh - 130px); box-sizing: border-box; }
.drill-what { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--muted); }
.drill-body .table-wrap { max-height: 420px; }
.shared-dialog .builder-foot { position: sticky; bottom: 0; background: var(--panel-bg); }

/* Sharing: the link and its copy button */
.share-text { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.5; }
.share-link { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.share-link input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

/* THE TOUR: everything else dimmed around a spotlight, and a card beside it */
.tour { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 80; }
.tour-blocker { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
.tour-spot {
    position: fixed;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 9999px rgba(10, 12, 16, 0.6);
    outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: left 0.2s, top 0.2s, width 0.2s, height 0.2s;
}
.tour-card {
    position: fixed;
    width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 16px));
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 14px 16px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
}
.tour-step { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.tour-card h2 { margin: 4px 0 6px; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.tour-card p { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text-2); }
.tour-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.tour-spacer { flex: 1; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .tour-spot { transition: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .view-btn.save { margin-left: 0; }
    .builder-dest { width: 100%; }
}

/* =====================================================================
   TICKET RESULTS AND STARRED TICKETS: ticking rows to remove or unstar
   them together, unstar by issue, and each ticket's parent and family
   ===================================================================== */

.result-table .select-cell { width: 28px; min-width: 28px; padding-right: 0; }
.select-cell input { width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: 2px 0 0; accent-color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; }
.result-table tbody tr.selected,
.result-table tbody tr.selected:nth-child(even) { background: var(--accent-soft); }
.select-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 12px; margin: 10px 0; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.select-count { min-width: 9em; }
.select-bar .home-action:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

/* The parent and the families (each opens its anchor's record) */
.result-table td.family-cell { min-width: 220px; }
.family-chip {
    display: inline-block;
    margin: 0 4px 4px 0;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    background: var(--info-soft);
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: 999px;
    color: var(--link);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
}
button.family-chip { cursor: pointer; }
button.family-chip:hover { border-color: var(--info); }
button.family-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }
span.family-chip { color: var(--text-2); background: var(--surface-3); }

/* "Unstar by issue": one button per family two or more starred tickets share */
.issue-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 10px 0; }
.issue-label { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-2); }
.issue-more { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); }
.issue-unstar {
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--warn-line);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    color: var(--warn-ink);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.issue-unstar:hover { background: var(--warn-softer); }

/* =====================================================================
   ASKING THE AI ABOUT TICKED TICKETS, AND A RECORD'S FAMILY FIRST
   ===================================================================== */

/* 💬 Ask the AI about the ticked tickets: a question box under the bar */
.ask-selected { margin: -2px 0 12px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--accent-softer); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 8px; }
.ask-selected-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.ask-selected-input {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 7px 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}
.ask-suggestions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 8px; }
.ask-chip {
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px dashed var(--accent);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    color: var(--accent-ink);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.ask-chip:hover { border-style: solid; background: var(--accent-soft); }

/* A record: its family above its fields */
.record-fields { margin-top: 14px; }
.record-fields-title { font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.related-slot + .record-fields { margin-top: 0; }
.ticket-head + .ticket-summary + .related-slot .related,
.ticket-head + .related-slot .related { margin-top: 4px; border-top: none; padding-top: 0; }
.related-none { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.88rem; }
/* "INC1813970 is a child incident. Its parent is INC1813985 (the first row)…" */
.family-where { margin: 6px 0 4px; padding: 6px 10px; background: var(--info-soft); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
/* A big family: the first 25 members, then "Show all" */
.family.collapsed tr.more-member { display: none; }
.family-show-all { margin-top: 8px; }

/* =====================================================================
   👪 TICKET FAMILIES (families.js): a page in the Dashboards tab, and the
   window a ticket opens in
   ===================================================================== */

.families-view { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 16px 20px 32px; }
/* One tab per kind of family, with how many there are */
.families-kinds { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.family-kind {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 999px;
    padding: 6px 14px;
    color: var(--text-2);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    cursor: pointer;
}
.family-kind:hover { border-color: var(--faint); }
.family-kind.active { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
.family-kind:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
.family-kind-count { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; padding: 0 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-3); color: var(--text-2); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.family-kind.active .family-kind-count { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25); color: var(--on-accent); }
.families-tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px 16px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
.families-find { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex: 1 1 360px; max-width: 560px; }
.families-find input,
.families-sort select {
    padding: 7px 10px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: var(--panel-bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
}
.families-find input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
.families-sort { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-2); }
.families-about { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.5; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.families-about .home-action { margin-left: 6px; }
.families-table { max-height: none; }
.result-table tbody tr.family-row { cursor: pointer; }
.result-table tbody tr.family-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: -2px; }
.result-table tbody tr.family-row.expanded,
.result-table tbody tr.family-row.expanded:nth-child(even) { background: var(--accent-soft); }
tr.family-row.expanded .expand-caret { transform: rotate(90deg); color: var(--accent); }
.family-size { font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.family-anchor-text { font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-2); }
.families-more { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-top: 12px; }
.families-more .home-status { margin: 0; }

/* The ticket window: ← Back and the ticket's name in its head */
.ticket-dialog-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.ticket-dialog-nav h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.1rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

/* A ticket record in a team dashboard: its family in a band above the page,
   scrolling on its own so the record below keeps most of the height */
.record-family { flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--bg-primary); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
.dashboard-body:has(#dashboard-frame[hidden]) .record-family { display: none; }
.record-family-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px 16px; padding: 8px 20px; }
.record-family-summary { margin: 0; min-width: 0; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.45; }
.record-family-summary b { color: var(--text); }
.record-family-head .home-action { flex-shrink: 0; }
.record-family-body { max-height: min(30vh, 320px); overflow-y: auto; padding: 0 20px 10px; }
.record-family-body .related { margin-top: 0; padding-top: 0; border-top: none; }
.record-family-body .related-title { display: none; } /* the line above says it */
.record-family-body .family .table-wrap { max-height: none; } /* one scroll: the band's */

@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .families-view { padding: 12px 16px 24px; }
    .families-find { flex-basis: 100%; }
    .record-family-head { padding: 8px 16px; }
    .record-family-body { max-height: 24vh; padding: 0 16px 10px; }
}

/* =====================================================================
   SIGN-IN PAGE (from styles2.css; every rule is scoped to .login-page
   so it cannot restyle the app behind it)
   ===================================================================== */

/* Until sign-in only the login page shows; afterwards only the app */
body.signed-out .app-header,
body.signed-out .app-content { display: none; }
body:not(.signed-out) .login-page { display: none; }

.login-page {
  --brand: #4f46e5;
  --ink: #111827;
  --muted: #6b7280;
  --line: #e5e7eb;
  --bad: #dc2626;
  --ok: #15803d;

  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  overflow-y: auto;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  align-content: start;
  justify-items: center;
  padding: 0 16px 28px;
  /* Wheat photo filling the screen; the color shows while it loads */
  background: #c8973f url("login-background.jpg") center / cover no-repeat;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
}

.login-page *,
.login-page *::before,
.login-page *::after {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.login-page a {
  color: var(--brand);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.login-page a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.login-page input,
.login-page select,
.login-page button { font: inherit; }

.login-page :focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--brand);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* Page layout / branding */
.login-page .login-brand {
  display: block;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 48px 0 0;
}

/* Sign-in card */
.login-page .box {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 430px;
  margin-top: 24px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 38px 34px;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 34px rgba(17, 24, 39, .06);
}

/* Typography */
.login-page .mark {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: var(--brand);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: #fff;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-bottom: 22px;
}

.login-page h1 {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
}

.login-page .sub {
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .93rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
}

.login-page label {
  display: block;
  font-size: .85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.login-page .password-label { margin-top: 16px; }

/* Form fields / inputs */
.login-page .field {
  width: 100%;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: .95rem;
  transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s;
  background: #fff;
  color: inherit;
}

.login-page .field:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--brand);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79, 70, 229, .15);
}

.login-page .combo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s;
  background: #fff;
}

.login-page .combo:focus-within {
  border-color: var(--brand);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79, 70, 229, .15);
}

.login-page .combo input {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  border: 0;
  padding: 12px 4px 12px 14px;
  font-size: .95rem;
  background: none;
}

.login-page .combo input:focus { outline: none; }

.login-page .combo .suffix {
  padding: 12px 14px 12px 2px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .95rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  background: #f5f6fa;
  align-self: stretch;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
}

/* Wrong email/password message; takes no space while empty */
.login-page .login-error {
  color: var(--bad);
  font-size: .88rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-top: 12px;
}
.login-page .login-error:empty { display: none; }

/* CTA buttons / providers */
.login-page .btn {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 13px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: var(--brand);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: .97rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background .15s;
}

.login-page .btn:hover { background: #4338ca; }
.login-page .btn:disabled { opacity: .7; cursor: wait; }

.login-page .provs {
  display: grid;
  gap: 9px;
  margin: 24px 0 0;
}

.login-page .prov {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 11px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: #fff;
  font-size: .92rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ink);
  cursor: pointer;
  text-align: left;
  transition: background .15s, border-color .15s;
}

.login-page .prov:hover {
  background: #f5f6fa;
  border-color: #cbd0dd;
}

.login-page .prov .ic {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-size: .68rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #fff;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Divider / footer */
.login-page .or {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 24px 0 4px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .8rem;
  letter-spacing: .08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.login-page .or::before,
.login-page .or::after {
  content: "";
  flex: 1;
  height: 1px;
  background: var(--line);
}

.login-page .foot {
  margin-top: 22px;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: .88rem;
  text-align: center;
}

/* Responsive / accessibility */
@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .login-page .box { padding: 28px 20px; }
  .login-page .combo .suffix {
    font-size: .85rem;
    padding-left: 6px;
    padding-right: 10px;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .login-page *,
  .login-page *::before,
  .login-page *::after {
    transition: none !important;
    animation: none !important;
  }
}
```

### B.27 `public/app.js`

```js
// =====================================================================
// SIGN IN: the server checks the credentials and hands back a session
// token, which every API call then sends as "Authorization: Bearer ..."
// =====================================================================

// The API lives on the same server that served this page, whether that's
// localhost:8000, this computer's network address, or a tunnel link. Only a
// page opened straight from disk (file://) has no server, so fall back then.
const API_BASE = location.protocol.startsWith('http') ? location.origin : 'http://localhost:8000';
const TOKEN_KEY = 'onetouch-session';

// sessionStorage can be blocked (private windows, strict settings)
function readToken() {
    try { return sessionStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY); } catch { return null; }
}
function saveToken(token) {
    try {
        if (token) sessionStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
        else sessionStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
    } catch { /* stays signed in until the page is reloaded */ }
}

let sessionTokenValue = readToken();

function authHeaders() {
    return sessionTokenValue ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${sessionTokenValue}` } : {};
}

function showLoginError(message) {
    document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = message || '';
}

// Signed in: the home page, with this person's starred tickets, layout and colors
function showApp(signedIn) {
    document.body.classList.toggle('signed-out', !signedIn);
    if (signedIn) {
        switchTab('home');
        loadStars();
        loadPreferences();
    } else if (!fillSignInLink()) {
        document.getElementById('login-email').focus();
    }
}

// A sign-in link (…/#user=jsmith&pass=secret) fills in the form, and the
// person still clicks the button. The part after "#" is never sent to the
// server (or the tunnel), and it is taken out of the address bar at once.
let signInLink = null;
function readSignInLink() {
    let details = location.hash.slice(1);
    // Some apps escape the "=" and "&" when they open a link (#user%3Djsmith%26pass%3D…)
    if (!/[=&]/.test(details) && /%3D/i.test(details)) {
        try { details = decodeURIComponent(details); } catch { /* read as it is */ }
    }
    const params = new URLSearchParams(details);
    if (!params.has('user')) return false;
    signInLink = { user: params.get('user') || '', pass: params.get('pass') || '' };
    history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname + location.search);
    return true;
}
function fillSignInLink() {
    if (!signInLink || !document.body.classList.contains('signed-out')) return false;
    document.getElementById('login-email').value = signInLink.user;
    document.getElementById('login-password').value = signInLink.pass;
    // A link with just the username: the password is typed next
    document.getElementById(signInLink.pass ? 'login-btn' : 'login-password').focus();
    signInLink = null;
    showLoginError('');
    return true;
}
// Opened while someone is signed in in this tab: their session stays, and the
// form is filled in when they sign out
function signInLinkWhileSignedIn() {
    if (!signInLink || !currentUsername) return;
    const user = signInLink.user.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/@molsoncoors\.com$/, '');
    if (user === currentUsername) signInLink = null;
    else showToast(`That link signs in as ${user}. You're signed in as ${currentUsername}: sign out to use it.`);
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => {
    if (!readSignInLink()) return;
    if (!fillSignInLink()) signInLinkWhileSignedIn();
});

// The signed-in person's name, shown in the header and the greetings
// (their display name, or their username if they don't have one)
let currentUserName = '';
let currentUsername = '';
// What this person may see and do (teams.mjs on the server):
// { admin, role, roleName, team: { id, name }, tickets, note }
const NO_ACCESS = { admin: false, role: null, roleName: null, team: null, tickets: 0, note: null };
let currentAccess = NO_ACCESS;

function setCurrentUser(user) {
    currentUserName = user ? (user.displayName || user.username || '') : '';
    currentUsername = user ? (user.username || '') : '';
    document.getElementById('user-name').textContent = currentUserName;
    if (!user) currentAccess = NO_ACCESS;
    else if (user.access) currentAccess = user.access;
    // The Team tab: admins, and anyone on a team
    document.getElementById('teams-tab').hidden = !(currentAccess.admin || currentAccess.team);
    renderGreetings();
    // Each person's home page opens on the search they used last
    if (currentUsername) setHomeMode(rememberedHomeMode());
}

// Just the first name: "Cassidy Sotelo" -> "Welcome, Cassidy!" on the home
// page and "Hello, Cassidy!" at the top of the chat
function renderGreetings() {
    const firstName = currentUserName.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];
    document.getElementById('home-welcome').textContent = firstName ? `Welcome, ${firstName}!` : 'Welcome!';
    const welcome = document.getElementById('welcome-msg');
    if (welcome) welcome.textContent = firstName ? `Hello, ${firstName}!` : 'Hello!';
}

// Who owns the stored session (after a reload, the name isn't known yet)
async function loadCurrentUser() {
    if (!sessionTokenValue) return;
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/me`, { headers: authHeaders() });
        if (handleUnauthorized(response)) return;
        if (response.ok) {
            setCurrentUser(await response.json());
            signInLinkWhileSignedIn();
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('Could not load the signed-in user:', err);
    }
}

async function signIn() {
    const button = document.getElementById('login-btn');
    const passwordField = document.getElementById('login-password');
    showLoginError('');
    button.disabled = true;

    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/login`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
                username: document.getElementById('login-email').value,
                password: passwordField.value,
            }),
        });
        const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (!response.ok || !data.token) {
            showLoginError(data.error || 'Sign-in failed. Please try again.');
            passwordField.value = '';
            passwordField.focus();
            return;
        }
        sessionTokenValue = data.token;
        saveToken(data.token);
        passwordField.value = '';
        clearChat();
        setCurrentUser(data);
        showApp(true);
        // What they may see, then their last chat (saved to their account)
        loadCurrentUser().then(resumeLatestChat);
    } catch (err) {
        showLoginError('Could not reach the OneTouch server. Please try again.');
        console.error(err);
    } finally {
        button.disabled = false;
    }
}

function signOut(message) {
    if (sessionTokenValue) {
        fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/logout`, { method: 'POST', headers: authHeaders() }).catch(() => {});
    }
    sessionTokenValue = null;
    saveToken(null);
    // The next person to sign in on this computer must not see this person's
    // chat, searches or stars
    toggleAssistant(false);
    clearChat();
    setCurrentUser(null);
    resetHome();
    resetTeams();
    resetCustomizing();
    showLoginError(typeof message === 'string' ? message : '');
    showApp(false);
}

// An expired session (or a server restart) sends the user back to sign in
function handleUnauthorized(response) {
    if (response.status !== 401) return false;
    signOut('Your session has ended. Please sign in again.');
    return true;
}

// =====================================================================
// CONVERSATION MEMORY: the server keeps this session's questions and
// Claude's answers, so follow-ups ("same but for changes") work, and saves
// each chat to the person's account after every answer. "New chat" starts
// a fresh one; the old one stays under "Chat History", where reopening it
// shows its answers again and Claude remembers it.
// =====================================================================

const WELCOME_HTML = document.getElementById('chat-log').innerHTML;

// Bumped whenever the chat is cleared, so an answer still on its way for the
// old conversation is dropped instead of landing in the new one
let chatEpoch = 0;

// Back to just the greeting (with the signed-in person's name)
function clearChat() {
    chatEpoch += 1;
    document.getElementById('chat-log').innerHTML = WELCOME_HTML;
    forgetRemovedExports();
    toggleChatHistory(false);
    renderGreetings();
    updateChatControls();
}

// remove: also delete the chat from the history ("Delete chat")
async function resetConversation(remove = false) {
    if (!sessionTokenValue) return;
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/conversation/reset`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...authHeaders() },
            body: JSON.stringify({ delete: remove }),
        });
        handleUnauthorized(response);
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('Could not reset the conversation:', err);
    }
}

async function newChat() {
    await resetConversation();
    clearChat();
    document.getElementById('user-prompt').focus();
}

// "Delete chat": after a confirmation, the questions and answers disappear,
// Claude forgets the conversation, it leaves the history, and the chat closes
async function deleteChat() {
    if (!document.querySelector('#chat-log .user-msg')) {
        toggleAssistant(false);
        return;
    }
    if (!confirm('Delete this chat? Its questions and answers disappear, it leaves your chat history, and the AI assistant forgets the conversation.')) return;
    clearChat();
    toggleAssistant(false);
    await resetConversation(true);
    showToast('Chat deleted');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------
// CHAT HISTORY: the list over the chat, newest first. Opening one draws
// its answers again and Claude carries on with it.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------

function chatHistoryOpen() {
    return !document.getElementById('chat-history').hidden;
}

function toggleChatHistory(open) {
    const box = document.getElementById('chat-history');
    const willOpen = typeof open === 'boolean' ? open : box.hidden;
    box.hidden = !willOpen;
    document.getElementById('chat-history-btn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(willOpen));
    if (willOpen) loadChatHistory();
}

function formatChatWhen(iso) {
    const d = new Date(iso);
    const today = new Date();
    const sameDay = d.toDateString() === today.toDateString();
    return sameDay
        ? d.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: 'numeric', minute: '2-digit' })
        : d.toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: d.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear() ? undefined : 'numeric' });
}

async function loadChatHistory() {
    const list = document.getElementById('chat-history-list');
    list.innerHTML = '<p class="home-status">Loading your chat history…</p>';
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/chats`, { headers: authHeaders() });
        if (handleUnauthorized(response)) return;
        const data = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Could not load your chat history.');
        if (!chatHistoryOpen()) return;
        list.innerHTML = data.chats.length
            ? data.chats.map(c => `
                <div class="chat-history-item${c.current ? ' current' : ''}">
                    <button type="button" class="chat-history-open" onclick="openSavedChat(${c.id})" title="${c.current ? 'This is the chat you have open' : 'Open this chat and carry on where you left off'}">
                        <span class="chat-history-title">${escapeHtml(c.title)}</span>
                        <span class="chat-history-meta">${c.current ? 'Open now · ' : ''}${c.questions} ${c.questions === 1 ? 'question' : 'questions'} · ${escapeHtml(formatChatWhen(c.updatedAt))}</span>
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" class="chat-history-delete" onclick="deleteSavedChat(${c.id})" title="Delete this chat" aria-label="Delete this chat">🗑</button>
                </div>`).join('')
            : '<p class="home-status">No saved chats yet. Each chat is saved here after its first answer.</p>';
    } catch (err) {
        list.innerHTML = `<p class="home-status error">❌ ${escapeHtml(err.message)}</p>`;
        console.error(err);
    }
}

// After a refresh or signing in: the chat they had last comes back, so
// nothing is lost (New chat starts a fresh one; this one stays in the history)
async function resumeLatestChat() {
    if (!sessionTokenValue || document.querySelector('#chat-log .user-msg')) return;
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/chats`, { headers: authHeaders() });
        if (!response.ok) return;
        const { chats } = await response.json();
        if (chats.length && !document.querySelector('#chat-log .user-msg')) await openSavedChat(chats[0].id, { quiet: true });
    } catch (err) {
        console.error('Could not reopen the last chat:', err);
    }
}

// Shows a saved chat's questions and answers, and Claude remembers it again.
// quiet: reopened by itself (after a refresh), so the cursor stays where it is.
async function openSavedChat(id, { quiet = false } = {}) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/chats/${id}/open`, { method: 'POST', headers: authHeaders() });
        if (handleUnauthorized(response)) return;
        const data = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Could not open that chat.');
        clearChat();
        for (const entry of data.transcript) {
            appendMessage('user-msg', escapeHtml(entry.question));
            const reply = entry.reply || {};
            showAnswer(entry.question, reply, reply.elapsedMs ? reply.elapsedMs / 1000 : null, { replay: true });
        }
        if (!quiet) document.getElementById('user-prompt').focus();
    } catch (err) {
        if (quiet) return console.error(err);
        showToast(err.message);
        loadChatHistory();
        console.error(err);
    }
}

async function deleteSavedChat(id) {
    if (!confirm('Delete this chat? It leaves your chat history and can\'t be brought back.')) return;
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/chats/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE', headers: authHeaders() });
        if (handleUnauthorized(response)) return;
        const data = await response.json();
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Could not delete that chat.');
        // The open chat was the one deleted: the screen starts over too
        if (data.current) {
            clearChat();
            toggleChatHistory(true);
        } else {
            loadChatHistory();
        }
        showToast('Chat deleted');
    } catch (err) {
        showToast(err.message);
        console.error(err);
    }
}

// The logo and the name "OneTouch": back to Home from anywhere, closing
// whatever is open on top (the chat, the dashboards drawer)
function goHome() {
    toggleAssistant(false);
    toggleDashboardDrawer(false);
    toggleThemePanel(false);
    switchTab('home');
    document.getElementById('home-view').scrollTop = 0;
}

// Pages: Home (the logo, or its button) and Dashboards; the page showing lights up.
// The AI assistant opens over either.
function switchTab(viewName) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.tab === viewName));
    document.querySelectorAll('.view-panel').forEach(panel => panel.classList.toggle('active', panel.id === `${viewName}-view`));
    // The first time someone sees Dashboards: its tour (customize.js)
    if (viewName === 'dashboard') loadDashboards().then(() => maybeStartTour('dashboards'));
    // The Team tab, fresh each time (assignments change)
    if (viewName === 'teams') loadTeams();
    // Stars may have changed elsewhere (the chat, a dashboard, another computer)
    if (viewName === 'home') {
        if (homeMode === 'starred') showStarred();
        else showTicketResults(true);
    }
}

// =====================================================================
// AI ASSISTANT: the chat opens over the page from Home's "Any question about
// the data" card (Open chat, or its example question). Minimize closes it and
// keeps the conversation; Delete chat removes it.
// =====================================================================

function assistantOpen() {
    return document.getElementById('assistant-panel').classList.contains('open');
}

// Opens or closes the conversation (no argument: the opposite of now)
function toggleAssistant(open) {
    const panel = document.getElementById('assistant-panel');
    const willOpen = typeof open === 'boolean' ? open : !assistantOpen();
    panel.classList.toggle('open', willOpen);
    document.getElementById('assistant-backdrop').classList.toggle('open', willOpen);
    document.getElementById('open-chat-btn').setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(willOpen));
    if (willOpen) {
        const chatLog = document.getElementById('chat-log');
        chatLog.scrollTop = chatLog.scrollHeight;
        document.getElementById('user-prompt').focus();
    } else if (panel.contains(document.activeElement)) {
        document.getElementById('open-chat-btn').focus();
    }
    updateChatControls();
}

// Asks a question as if typed into the chat, opening it to show the answer
function askAssistant(question) {
    toggleAssistant(true);
    document.getElementById('user-prompt').value = question;
    sendPrompt();
}

// Home's chat buttons: Open chat says how many questions the conversation has,
// and Delete chat appears once there is something to delete
function updateChatControls() {
    const asked = document.querySelectorAll('#chat-log .user-msg').length;
    document.getElementById('open-chat-btn').textContent = asked ? `💬 Open chat (${asked})` : '💬 Open chat';
    document.getElementById('delete-chat-btn').hidden = !asked;
}

// =====================================================================
// DASHBOARDS TAB: the Metabase dashboards made by scripts/metabase-setup.mjs,
// shown through the OneTouch server (so they work from any address)
// =====================================================================

// Every page the frame can show, by its public id: the drawer's dashboards,
// and the detail pages a click on a chart opens
const dashboardPages = { main: new Map(), details: new Map() };
let currentMainDashboard = null;
const pageId = path => (String(path).match(/\/public\/dashboard\/([0-9a-f-]{36})/) || [])[1];

// The dashboard each person had open last ("my:<id>" for one of their own),
// saved to their account so it opens there next time, on any computer
function rememberedDashboard() {
    return prefs.dashboards.last || '';
}
function rememberDashboard(key) {
    if (prefs.dashboards.last === key || !sessionTokenValue || prefsLoadFailed) return;
    prefs.dashboards.last = key;
    savePreference('dashboards');
}

// How the frame shows a dashboard: no extra border or title (the toolbar
// above names it), and Metabase's dark look when OneTouch is dark
function frameHash() {
    return `#bordered=false&titled=false${document.documentElement.dataset.theme === 'dark' ? '&theme=night' : ''}`;
}

// A page's own hash with OneTouch's look in it, keeping everything else it
// says (a detail page hides some of its filters there). Kept as written,
// because Metabase reads it without turning "+" into spaces.
function themedFrameHash(hash) {
    const options = hash.replace(/^#/, '').split('&').filter(o => o && !o.startsWith('theme='));
    if (document.documentElement.dataset.theme === 'dark') options.push('theme=night');
    return `#${options.join('&')}`;
}
const frameHashIsDark = hash => /(^#|&)theme=night(&|$)/.test(hash);

// Light <-> dark: the dashboard in the frame reloads in the matching look
function refreshDashboardTheme() {
    if (!frameHasPage()) return;
    try {
        const where = document.getElementById('dashboard-frame').contentWindow.location;
        where.replace(`${where.pathname}${where.search}${themedFrameHash(where.hash)}`);
        where.reload();
    } catch { /* not ours */ }
}

// Loads the drawer once; resolves true when the dashboards are there.
// Shared, so the tab and "Open in Dashboards" never load it twice.
let dashboardsLoading = null;
function loadDashboards() {
    if (!dashboardsLoading) {
        dashboardsLoading = buildDashboards().then(ok => {
            if (!ok) dashboardsLoading = null; // try again next time
            return ok;
        });
    }
    return dashboardsLoading;
}

async function buildDashboards() {
    const picker = document.getElementById('dashboard-picker');
    const message = document.getElementById('dashboard-message');
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/dashboards`, { headers: authHeaders() });
        if (handleUnauthorized(response)) return false;
        const { dashboards, details = [], restricted = false } = await response.json();
        for (const d of dashboards) dashboardPages.main.set(pageId(d.path), d);
        for (const d of details) dashboardPages.details.set(pageId(d.path), d);
        // Which team dashboards this person hid, and which one they had open
        await prefsReady;
        if (restricted) {
            // Metabase shows every ticket, so only admins get those dashboards;
            // Ticket families and their own dashboards show only their tickets
            document.getElementById('drawer-customize').hidden = true;
            const last = rememberedDashboard();
            if (last === 'families') { showFamilies(); return true; }
            if (last.startsWith('my:') && showBoard(last.slice(3))) return true;
            message.textContent = 'The Metabase team dashboards show every ticket, so only admins can open them. ' +
                'Under ☰ Dashboards, Ticket families and your own dashboards show the tickets you can see.';
            return true;
        }
        if (!dashboards.length) {
            message.textContent = 'No team dashboards yet. Whoever runs this OneTouch server can create them with: ' +
                'docker exec analytics_node_app node scripts/metabase-setup.mjs. You can still build your own under ☰ Dashboards.';
            return false;
        }

        // The drawer: one heading per group, dashboards in the order the server lists them
        const groups = new Map();
        for (const d of dashboards) {
            if (!groups.has(d.group)) groups.set(d.group, []);
            groups.get(d.group).push(d);
        }
        picker.innerHTML = '';
        for (const [group, items] of groups) {
```
